blinding_and_isolation.isolation_scope: Command-local only: the prediction-freeze command accepts no receptor-outcome inputs and reads no outcome cells. The public workbooks had previously been parsed for checksum, censoring, and overlap audits.
blinding_and_isolation.temporal_lock: Predictions and their receipt must be committed before the separate scoring command reads receptor outcomes.

final_ridge_rule.features: The fixed 30-position, 21-symbol one-hot encoding from configs/cpu_sequence_model.json.
final_ridge_rule.alpha_selection: Use all 125 development records only. Leave one of the 17 frozen sequence components out in turn and minimize component-macro two-receptor MAE over the already frozen alpha grid; break ties toward smaller alpha.
final_ridge_rule.final_fit: Refit both receptor targets on all 125 development records with equal total weight per frozen sequence component and the selected alpha.
final_ridge_rule.selectivity: Predicted GCGR log10(pM) minus predicted GLP-1R log10(pM); no selectivity model is fit.

comparators.primary: Tied 1-nearest-neighbour over all 125 development sequences; average log10(pM) outcomes across every maximum-identity tie.
comparators.secondary_all_row_median: Per-receptor median of all 125 development log10(pM) outcomes.
comparators.secondary_component_mean: Per-receptor component-balanced mean of development log10(pM) outcomes, giving each frozen component equal total weight.

label_free_parent_clusters.derivation: Construct a bipartite graph connecting each P1-P15 design to every development peptide tied at its maximum aligned identity within 1e-12. Parent clusters are connected components of design nodes through shared donor nodes and transitive closure; sort by minimum numeric P ID to assign PC001 onward.
label_free_parent_clusters.role: Nearest-donor proxy sensitivity; these five clusters are not assumed independent.

label_free_external_components.derivation: Build the P1-P15-only graph with an edge when aligned identity is at least 0.85 within 1e-12; take transitive connected components and sort by minimum numeric P ID.
label_free_external_components.role: Headline descriptive resampling unit; four components are too few for inferential significance.

label_free_combined_components.derivation: Join each external sequence to every frozen development component containing a sequence at aligned identity at least 0.85, retain P1-P15 external edges at the same threshold, and take transitive connected components.
label_free_combined_components.role: Strongest dependence sensitivity; report macro and leave-one-linked-component-out contrasts, not a three-group bootstrap.

primary_scoring.aggregate: For three observed replicates, score log10 of their arithmetic mean EC50 in pM. If any replicate is right-censored and none is missing, score against the lower bound log10((sum observed values + sum censoring thresholds) / 3).
primary_scoring.loss: Absolute error for exact aggregates; max(0, lower_bound - prediction) for right-censored aggregates. The latter is an optimistic constraint-violation lower bound, not exact prediction error.
primary_scoring.primary_comparison: Ridge loss minus tied 1-NN loss, retained separately for GCGR and GLP-1R.
primary_scoring.uncertainty: Headline descriptive interval uses 10,000 paired resamples of four whole P1-P15 external sequence components frozen at aligned identity 0.85. Each sampled component retains all member peptides, and the sampled estimand is pooled loss difference across all sampled peptide members.
primary_scoring.uncertainty_warning: Only four external components exist. This is a descriptive resampling interval, not an inferential confidence interval, and cannot support a significance or superiority claim regardless of whether it crosses zero. Shared design-process dependence can remain across components; the combined graph has only three linked groups.
primary_scoring.stability: Report all four leave-one-external-component-out deltas/range, five nearest-parent-proxy leave-one-out deltas/range, and three linked-component macro/leave-one-out sensitivities. Call the conclusion unstable if direction changes among dependence definitions.

selectivity_scoring.definition: GCGR log10 mean EC50 minus GLP-1R log10 mean EC50.
selectivity_scoring.interval_rule: Exact-exact gives a point; GCGR-censored only gives a lower bound; GLP-1R-censored only gives an upper bound; both censored is uninformative and excluded from constraint loss.
selectivity_scoring.loss: Absolute error for a point, max(0, lower-prediction) for a lower bound, and max(0, prediction-upper) for an upper bound.

secondary_scoring.replicate_sensitivity: Retain all 90 receptor replicate cells. Exact cells use absolute error; right-censored cells use max(0, threshold-prediction). Replicates are not treated as independent primary observations.
secondary_scoring.complete_case_metrics: Point metrics are descriptive and restricted to peptide-receptor records with three exact replicates; selectivity point metrics require both receptors to be exact.
secondary_scoring.group_summaries: Retain primary peptide-level loss separately for dual, GCGR-selective, and GLP-1R-selective intended design groups.
secondary_scoring.naive_peptide_bootstrap: Retain the 10,000-draw design-group-stratified 15-peptide bootstrap only as an explicitly anti-conservative sensitivity analysis; it is not headline uncertainty because designs share development parents.

prohibitions: Do not select features, alpha, baselines, thresholds, or endpoints using P1-P15 outcomes.
Do not refit or recalibrate any model using P1-P15 outcomes.
Do not replace censored values with their thresholds as exact observations.
Do not suppress an endpoint, comparator, intended design group, or unfavorable result after scoring.
